name: mcal_list_events
description: List events in one calendar (by `calendar` slug), soonest first. Optional `from` and `to` bounds (UTC ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-28T00:00:00Z) restrict the time window; omit both to list everything. Each event has: id (UUID), title, description, location, starts_at, ends_at, all_day, source ('portal'|'google'), status. Use this to find an event's `id` before mcal_get_event / mcal_update_event / mcal_delete_event.

from.description: Optional lower bound on the window, UTC ISO-8601. Omit for none.

to.description: Optional upper bound on the window, UTC ISO-8601. Omit for none.
